unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the current record.

evidence_requests: Provide the underlying record for the two paid pilot commitments showing whether this segment is a named launch use case or contractual customer segment.
Provide the legal review outcome, including whether disclosure is required.
Provide the actual launch disclosure/model card text, if any, showing this limitation was disclosed before launch.
Provide any approved risk-acceptance document that explicitly covers this unresolved limitation before launch.

decision_criteria: If the affected weakness touches a contractual customer segment or named launch use case, treat it as material under the provided policy text.
If legal review is pending on required disclosure, do not treat the disclosure predicate as satisfied without evidence.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results can support readiness, but they do not substitute for a required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
A compliant certification requires admissible evidence that the material limitation was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
